visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat stands precariously atop a tall stack of gray, textured panels positioned near a large window. The room is bright with natural light, and the cat looks directly at the camera with wide eyes while remaining stationary. (2) The camera angle shifts to a slightly lower perspective as the cat looks down at the ground, appearing hesitant. It moves its paws slightly but stays on the narrow ledge, its white chest and belly contrasting with its ginger back. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the cat's head as it meows, with its mouth clearly opening. The background shows a white-walled room with high ceilings and modern windows. (4) A man with long hair tied in a bun enters the frame from the left, reaching upward with both hands toward the cat. He wears a white t-shirt and dark shorts. (5) The man gently grips the cat's torso and lifts it into the air, slowly lowering it from the height of the panels. The cat's legs are dangling during the descent. (6) The cat is placed onto a large teal cardboard box on the floor. It immediately begins walking across the box toward a sliding glass door in the background. (7) The video transitions to a solid pink screen with white centered text indicating the channel's branding.
